answer: Build a trust graph from completed, independently paid collaborations and run bounded random walks from long-lived nodes. A newcomer needs several edge-disjoint paths into the established core; a farm connected through one sponsor bridge has low conductance, so its aliases share only a small reward quota. Publish the random seed and rotate the graph each epoch. An atlas can map links across a karst of groups, but a wharf edge alone cannot make a Sybil island trusted.
